config.notes: UTS course pages (www.uts.edu.au/courses/<slug>) are server-rendered in the DOMESTIC view; no page JSON. Header facts: CODE (UTS code + CRICOS), DURATION, INTAKE (session names only, e.g. "Autumn Session 2027 Spring Session 2027" - no month names), COURSE FEES (Domestic (FT) only), LOCATION. IELTS in Admission requirements ("IELTS Academic: overall 6.5, writing 6.0"). International fees are NOT on course pages: central 2027 international course summary tables (PDF, fee per session) and the UTS fee search. Start months come from the central principal dates: Autumn session = February, Spring session = July; research sessions January and July. Intakes pattern only yields months where the INTAKE block prints month names. 5 Oct (international view): the course page has a Domestic/International switch run in the browser. A rendered read with ?student=international&type=international showed the international view on some undergraduate pages (about 5 in 8 reads) and on no postgraduate page (0 in 9, with studentType, student, type, audience, region parameters and a #international fragment); the view is not reliably set by the address. International view prints 'International course fees 2027 Indicative tuition fees for international students Indicative First-Year tuition fee : $N Indicative Total tuition fee: $M'; the fee pattern reads the First-Year figure (one year full time) with its year. LOCATION (delivery) is the same in both views. Result 5 Oct: three rendered passes over the undergraduate pages (suffix ?student=international&type=international, then reordered and with view=3 for pages still domestic) gave the international view on 123 of 152 confirmed undergraduate rows; the view is set in the browser and is not guaranteed by the address, so a later re-read can come back domestic. Postgraduate pages never showed the international view (0 of 9 tests), so page_view is limited to /courses/bachelor-. 5 Oct 15:22 checks: no exit awards in the "N years of full-time study ... exit with" form (pages mention only internal course transfers and graduate certificate/diploma exit points without years), so no exit_awards pattern. Every international panel prints the First-Year fee next to the Indicative Total, so no fee_total pattern (the only two pages with a total but no first-year fee are single degrees bound to a Communication/Laws double-degree page). entry_requirement: the first sentence(s) of Admission requirements (same for domestic and international).
